# Visual fixtures

`visual_minimal.ppt` is a tiny PowerPoint 97–2003 presentation generated locally
with Microsoft PowerPoint COM (`scripts/make_visual_fixture.py`). It is not
redistributed third-party content. It contains two visible slides, one legacy
comment, and one speaker note attached to the second slide.

`visual_animation.ppt` is generated by `scripts/make_animation_fixture.py` and
exercises animation (and optionally transition audio) diagnostics.

`visual_animation_object.ppt` is generated by
`scripts/make_animation_object_fixture.py`. It contains one textbox with one
appear animation and no audio, links, macros, or embedded objects. PowerPoint
stores that single effect in both legacy `AnimationInfo` records and a
`___PPT10` timing tree plus a text `ParaBuildContainer`; all representations
must merge into one diagnostic.

`visual_ole.ppt` is generated by `scripts/make_ole_fixture.py`. It contains one
controlled embedded `Package` object backed by a temporary text payload; the
fixture has no external link, macro, or executable content.

`visual_chart.ppt` is generated by `scripts/make_chart_fixture.py`. It contains
one embedded legacy `MSGraph.Chart.8` object with no external workbook or link.
Its compressed OLE storage and cached preview are the controlled editable
chart round-trip evidence.

`visual_chart_animation.ppt` is generated by
`scripts/make_chart_animation_fixture.py`. It adds a by-series appear animation
to one embedded MS Graph chart, producing one `ChartBuildContainer` and three
actual timing effects without external links or macros.

`visual_equation_ole.ppt` is generated by
`scripts/make_equation_ole_fixture.py` from the pinned Apache POI `37625.ppt`
test-data blob. It contains one embedded `Equation.DSMT4` MathType object with
its cached preview and no external link, macro, audio, or video.

`visual_excel_ole.ppt` is generated by
`scripts/make_excel_ole_fixture.py` from the pinned Apache POI
`testPPT_oleWorkbook.ppt` test-data blob
`b0c9cc8afb48b4cb40a941112de3222206a9651d` (Apache License 2.0). It contains
one package-backed `Excel.Sheet.12` object with its cached preview and no
external link, macro, audio, or video.

`visual_smartart.ppt` is generated by `scripts/make_smartart_fixture.py` from
the pinned Apache POI `SmartArt.pptx` test-data blob
`7b7731d78f27352ccea5713400d4994058bcc381` (Apache License 2.0). PowerPoint
reduces it to one slide with one SmartArt shape before saving as legacy `.ppt`.
The shape carries one `metroBlob` OPC package containing diagram parts and no
macro, link, audio, video, or OLE object.

`visual_video.ppt` is generated by `scripts/make_video_fixture.py`. It contains
one deterministic one-second MP4 inserted through PowerPoint and then saved as
legacy `.ppt`. On reopen, PowerPoint exposes the object as a poster picture
with an `II_MediaAction`; the fixture contains no macro, external link, audio,
or OLE object.

`visual_background_picture.ppt` is generated by
`scripts/make_background_picture_fixture.py`. It contains one deterministic
PNG stored as the slide's stretched picture background and one editable
foreground textbox. It contains no macro, external link, audio, video, or OLE
object.

`visual_bullet_font.ppt` is generated by
`scripts/make_bullet_font_fixture.py`. It contains one editable text box with
three legacy Wingdings `w`/`n` bullet glyphs, two bullet colors, and 110%/60%
relative sizes. It contains no macro, external link, audio, video, or OLE
object.

`visual_zero_extent_lines.ppt` is generated by
`scripts/make_zero_extent_line_fixture.py` from the pinned Apache POI
`37625.ppt` test-data blob `d157798671bf2499d3add9a2cf152049975820e6`
(Apache License 2.0). It recreates the grouped master grid's 54 zero-axis line
objects individually on a new one-slide presentation master, avoiding unrelated
group coordinators. It contains no macro, external link, audio, video, or OLE
object.

`visual_master_shape_z_order.ppt` is generated by
`scripts/make_master_shape_z_order_fixture.py`. It contains one thick blue
master line crossing behind one yellow editable slide rectangle, with no
macro, external link, audio, video, or OLE object.

`visual_master_arc.ppt` is generated by
`scripts/make_master_arc_fixture.py` from the pinned Apache POI `37625.ppt`
test-data blob. It retains the original grouped OfficeArt shape type 19 arc,
makes the other group members non-rendering, and contains no macro, external
link, audio, video, or OLE object.

`visual_master_objects_disabled.ppt` is generated by
`scripts/make_master_objects_fixture.py`. It contains one red rectangle on the
master and one blue slide-local rectangle, while the slide clears
`fMasterObjects` through `DisplayMasterShapes=False`. It contains no macro,
external link, audio, video, or OLE object.

`visual_placeholder_anchor.ppt` is generated by
`scripts/make_placeholder_anchor_fixture.py`. PowerPoint creates one slide
title and a bottom-anchored master title; the generator then performs an
equal-length record rewrite that removes the slide's explicit OfficeArt PID
135 while extending its existing complex property data by six NUL bytes. The
master keeps `anchorText=bottom`, so the fixture isolates placeholder vertical
anchor inheritance without unrelated advanced objects or diagnostics.

`visual_header_footer_master.ppt` is generated by
`scripts/make_header_footer_master_fixture.py`. PowerPoint creates one blank
slide and styled master date/footer/slide-number placeholders. The generator
then replaces two adjacent empty header/footer records with one equal-length
legacy fixed-date container, isolating selected-master field geometry and text
style inheritance without unrelated objects or diagnostics.

Regenerate:

```console
PYTHONPATH=src python scripts/make_visual_fixture.py -o tests/fixtures/visual_minimal.ppt
PYTHONPATH=src python scripts/make_animation_fixture.py -o tests/fixtures/visual_animation.ppt
PYTHONPATH=src python scripts/make_animation_object_fixture.py -o tests/fixtures/visual_animation_object.ppt
PYTHONPATH=src python scripts/make_ole_fixture.py -o tests/fixtures/visual_ole.ppt
PYTHONPATH=src python scripts/make_chart_fixture.py -o tests/fixtures/visual_chart.ppt
PYTHONPATH=src python scripts/make_chart_animation_fixture.py -o tests/fixtures/visual_chart_animation.ppt
PYTHONPATH=src python scripts/make_equation_ole_fixture.py -o tests/fixtures/visual_equation_ole.ppt
PYTHONPATH=src python scripts/make_excel_ole_fixture.py -o tests/fixtures/visual_excel_ole.ppt
PYTHONPATH=src python scripts/make_smartart_fixture.py -o tests/fixtures/visual_smartart.ppt
PYTHONPATH=src python scripts/make_video_fixture.py -o tests/fixtures/visual_video.ppt
PYTHONPATH=src python scripts/make_background_picture_fixture.py -o tests/fixtures/visual_background_picture.ppt
PYTHONPATH=src python scripts/make_bullet_font_fixture.py -o tests/fixtures/visual_bullet_font.ppt
PYTHONPATH=src python scripts/make_zero_extent_line_fixture.py -o tests/fixtures/visual_zero_extent_lines.ppt
PYTHONPATH=src python scripts/make_master_shape_z_order_fixture.py -o tests/fixtures/visual_master_shape_z_order.ppt
PYTHONPATH=src python scripts/make_master_arc_fixture.py -o tests/fixtures/visual_master_arc.ppt
PYTHONPATH=src python scripts/make_master_objects_fixture.py -o tests/fixtures/visual_master_objects_disabled.ppt
PYTHONPATH=src python scripts/make_placeholder_anchor_fixture.py -o tests/fixtures/visual_placeholder_anchor.ppt
```
